source: WHO / United Nations international health days

days.name: World Braille Day
days.summary: Raises awareness of Braille as a communication tool for the visually impaired.
days.mpo_tip: Visit ophthalmologists and low-vision clinics with patient-education leaflets on eye-drop technique and vitamin A brands.

days.name: World Neglected Tropical Diseases Day
days.summary: Spotlight on NTDs that still burden rural Bangladesh.
days.mpo_tip: Plan upazila health-complex visits with anthelmintic and anti-leishmanial portfolios.

days.name: World Cancer Day
days.summary: Close the care gap — early detection and access to treatment.
days.mpo_tip: Book oncologists 10 days ahead with screening collaterals and supportive-care brands (antiemetics, G-CSF, analgesics).

days.name: International Childhood Cancer Day
days.summary: Childhood cancers are highly curable with timely referral.
days.mpo_tip: Leave paediatric oncology dosing cards at medical-college hospitals.

days.name: World Hearing Day
days.summary: Ear and hearing care for all.
days.mpo_tip: Target ENT chambers with otic drops, antibiotics and paediatric syrups.

days.name: World Kidney Day
days.summary: Kidney health for all — diabetes and hypertension are the leading drivers.
days.mpo_tip: Joint detailing with ARBs, SGLT2 inhibitors and phosphate binders at nephrology OPDs.

days.name: World Tuberculosis Day
days.summary: Yes! We can end TB.
days.mpo_tip: Coordinate with DOTS corners; leave adherence calendars for anti-TB and hepatoprotective brands.

days.name: World Health Day
days.summary: WHO's founding day — global health theme announced annually.
days.mpo_tip: Institutional visits to civil surgeon offices and upazila health complexes with primary-care portfolios.

days.name: World Hemophilia Day
days.summary: Access to treatment for bleeding disorders.
days.mpo_tip: Call on haematologists with factor-support and iron brands.

days.name: World Malaria Day
days.summary: Malaria still circulates in hill-tract and border districts.
days.mpo_tip: Focus Chattogram Hill Tracts and Cox's Bazar with antimalarials and rapid tests.

days.name: World Asthma Day
days.summary: First Tuesday of May — inhaler technique and control.
days.mpo_tip: Demo inhaler devices in chest clinics; leave spacer and peak-flow collaterals.

days.name: World Hand Hygiene Day
days.summary: Save lives: clean your hands.
days.mpo_tip: Hospital pharmacy + IPC committee visits with antiseptics and surgical scrubs.

days.name: World Thalassaemia Day
days.summary: High prevalence in Bangladesh — screening and chelation.
days.mpo_tip: Visit transfusion centres with iron chelators and folic-acid brands.

days.name: World Hypertension Day
days.summary: Measure your blood pressure, control it, live longer.
days.mpo_tip: BP-camp collaterals for ARB/ACEI/CCB portfolios; book medicine specialists.

days.name: World No Tobacco Day
days.summary: Protect people from tobacco industry interference.
days.mpo_tip: Cessation support + COPD inhaler detailing at chest and cardiac clinics.

days.name: World Blood Donor Day
days.summary: Give blood, give plasma, share life, share often.
days.mpo_tip: Partner with Red Crescent / hospital blood banks; iron and B12 brands.

days.name: World Hepatitis Day
days.summary: Hepatitis B and C elimination — test, treat, vaccinate.
days.mpo_tip: GI chambers: antivirals, hepatoprotectives, vaccine reminder cards.

days.name: World Breastfeeding Week (start)
days.summary: Protect, promote and support breastfeeding.
days.mpo_tip: Avoid formula push; focus maternal nutrition, iron, calcium at Gynae OPDs.

days.name: International Overdose Awareness Day
days.summary: Remember lives lost and prevent the next overdose.
days.mpo_tip: ER visits with NAC, activated charcoal and toxicology dosing cards.

days.name: World Suicide Prevention Day
days.summary: Creating hope through action.
days.mpo_tip: Psychiatry chambers: SSRI/SNRI portfolios with suicide-risk counselling leaflets.

days.name: World Alzheimer's Day
days.summary: Awareness and support for dementia carers.
days.mpo_tip: Neurology visits with AChE inhibitors and carer-support collaterals.

days.name: World Heart Day
days.summary: Use Heart for Action — CVD is the leading killer in Bangladesh.
days.mpo_tip: Highest-ROI day for MPOs: statin, antiplatelet, ARB, SGLT2 camps with cardiologists two weeks out.

days.name: International Day of Older Persons
days.summary: Healthy ageing and polypharmacy safety.
days.mpo_tip: Geriatric clinics: calcium/D3, antihypertensives, PPI stewardship cards.

days.name: World Mental Health Day
days.summary: Mental health is a universal human right.
days.mpo_tip: Psychiatrists + medicine specialists with anxiolytic/antidepressant portfolios.

days.name: World Arthritis Day
days.summary: Early diagnosis of inflammatory arthritis.
days.mpo_tip: Rheumatology chambers: NSAIDs, DMARD support, calcium/vitamin D.

days.name: World Osteoporosis Day
days.summary: Bone health across the life course.
days.mpo_tip: Ortho + gynae: calcium, vitamin D, bisphosphonate brands with FRAX cards.

days.name: World Stroke Day
days.summary: Minutes can save brain — FAST campaign.
days.mpo_tip: Neuro/cardiac: antiplatelets, statins, antihypertensives; FAST posters for chambers.

days.name: World Pneumonia Day
days.summary: Pneumonia remains a top killer of Bangladeshi children.
days.mpo_tip: Paediatricians: antibiotics, nebuliser solutions, vaccine reminders.

days.name: World Diabetes Day
days.summary: Blue circle day — 13+ million adults with diabetes in Bangladesh.
days.mpo_tip: Plan glucometer camps, metformin/SGLT2/DPP4 detailing, and diet leaflets 3 weeks ahead. Highest MPO activity day after Heart Day.

days.name: World COPD Day
days.summary: Third Wednesday of November — inhaler access and pulmonary rehab.
days.mpo_tip: Chest clinics: LAMA/LABA/ICS inhalers with device-training sessions.

days.name: World Antimicrobial Awareness Week (start)
days.summary: Go Blue for AMR — stewardship not just sales.
days.mpo_tip: Leave stewardship cards; promote culture-guided therapy over empirical broad-spectrum.

days.name: World AIDS Day
days.summary: End inequalities, end AIDS.
days.mpo_tip: ID clinics and NGO ART centres with opportunistic-infection brands.

days.name: International Day of Persons with Disabilities
days.summary: Inclusive health and rehabilitation.
days.mpo_tip: Rehab hospitals: neuropathic pain, muscle relaxants, vitamin D.
